text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This is really putting a lot of strain on my legs… However, my strides feel solid and powerful.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I have to perfect this running style!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: One more lap!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. I don't mean to overstep, but is Satono all right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I don't know if she's relying too much on brute force or overstraining herself, but she doesn't seem to be running with her usual finesse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've been training to strengthen her running in preparation for her race against Mejiro McQueen in the autumn Tenno Sho and future international races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, a truly unexpected development has arisen—Satono Diamond's running has become increasingly unstable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's almost as if she's struggling to control her strength properly.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It may only be because she's running on sand. I hope it's just a temporary issue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hope the same, but it's impossible to tell. For now, I'll continue to keep an eye on how things unfold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before long, the final day of summer camp is upon us.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's sit next to each other on the bus, Kita! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Way ahead of you! I've already put my bags on our seats to save them! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ummm, Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Zzz… Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: She's already asleep…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Zzz… I have to get… stronger…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You worked so hard during summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Good night, Dia.
